beach.name: Foggy beach
beach.description:
Thick fog rolls across the black sand. Waves crash against jagged rocks to the east and west.
Through the mist, a tall silhouette rises to the north - the lighthouse.
A piece of driftwood lies half-buried in the sand near your feet.

entrance.name: Lighthouse ground floor
entrance.description:
The cold stone interior of the lighthouse. Salt crusts the floor.
Spiral stairs climb up to the lantern room.
An iron hatch leads down to the cellar, but it is locked.
To the east, a wooden door leads to the keeper's quarters - also locked.
A rusty key hangs on a nail beside the eastern door.

quarters.name: Keeper's quarters
quarters.description:
A small room with a narrow bed, a wooden desk, and a coat rack.
A single bulb hangs from the ceiling, flickering despite the power being out.
On the desk, a leather journal lies open.
A brass key hangs from the coat rack.

cellar.name: Lighthouse cellar
cellar.description:
Damp and cold. The stone walls are covered in a strange blue-green moss that pulses faintly, like a slow heartbeat.
A wooden barrel sits in the corner.
Carvings cover the far wall - ancient symbols of spirals and tentacles.
Beneath them, someone has scratched words into the stone: 'When the light returns, they will answer.'

lantern.name: Lantern room
lantern.description:
The top of the lighthouse. A massive Fresnel lens dominates the room, its prismatic glass catching what little light there is.
Fog presses against every window.
An oil lamp sits in the center of the lens mechanism, its reservoir dry and empty.
You can hear the sea far below, and something else - a low humming, as if the lighthouse itself is breathing.

driftwood.name: driftwood
driftwood.description:
A weathered piece of driftwood with a small hollow carved into it.
Inside, you find a packet of matches, still dry.

searched.name: searched
searched.description: Just a piece of driftwood now. The hollow is empty.

matches.name: matches
matches.description: A small packet of waterproof matches. The box is labelled 'STRIKE ANYWHERE.'

quarters_key.name: rusty key
quarters_key.description: A small rusty key on a nail. It looks like it could open a wooden door.

cellar_key.name: brass key
cellar_key.description: A heavy brass key with a circular bow. It looks old but well-maintained.

journal.name: journal
journal.description:
A leather-bound journal. The pages are filled with a careful, looping handwriting.
The final entry reads:

'October 31st. The fog has not lifted in weeks. The lights below the waves grow brighter each night - they know the beacon is failing. I cannot leave. Someone must keep the signal alive. If you are reading this, the oil will be in the cellar. Light the lamp. They are waiting.'

The entry is signed with a name you cannot quite make out.

bed.name: narrow bed
bed.description: A single iron bed with a thin mattress. It hasn't been slept in for a long time.

desk.name: wooden desk
desk.description: A scarred wooden desk. The journal lies open on its surface.

locked_hatch.name: iron hatch
locked_hatch.description:
A heavy iron hatch set into the floor, leading down into darkness.
It is secured with a heavy padlock.

locked_quarters_door.name: wooden door
locked_quarters_door.description:
A solid wooden door leading to the keeper's quarters.
It is locked.

oil_barrel.name: wooden barrel
oil_barrel.description: A sturdy wooden barrel filled with lamp oil. The stopper is already removed.

oil.name: lamp oil
oil.description: Clear lamp oil with a faint blue tint. It smells of salt and something else - something you can't quite place.

glowing_moss.name: glowing moss
glowing_moss.description:
A bioluminescent moss that covers the stone walls. It pulses in a slow, rhythmic pattern - almost like breathing.
The light is faintly blue-green, like deep ocean water.

carvings.name: stone carvings
carvings.description:
Ancient carvings etched into the cellar wall. Spirals, tentacles, and eye-like symbols.
Someone has scratched a message beneath them: 'When the light returns, they will answer.'

fresnel_lens.name: Fresnel lens
fresnel_lens.description:
A massive first-order Fresnel lens, its concentric rings of prismatic glass catching and refracting every available photon.
It was designed to be seen for miles across the ocean.
Even in the dark, it looks hungry for light.

oil_lamp.name: oil lamp
oil_lamp.description:
A large brass oil lamp mounted in the center of the lens mechanism.
Its reservoir is dry and empty.
The wick is intact but charred from previous use.

empty.name: empty
empty.description: A large brass oil lamp. Its reservoir is dry.

filled.name: filled
filled.description:
A large brass oil lamp, now filled with oil.
The wick soaks up the fuel, ready to be lit.

lit.name: lit
lit.description:
The oil lamp burns with a steady, bright flame.
The Fresnel lens transforms it into a powerful beam that cuts through the fog.

fog_windows.name: fog-pressed windows
fog_windows.description:
Circular windows on every side, pressed with thick fog.
Beyond them, nothing is visible but grey.

start_event.name: Arrival
start_event.description:
You wake on the beach with no memory of how you arrived.
The fog is thick. The cold seeps through your clothes.
Ahead, a lighthouse stands against the grey sky.
You have no choice but to investigate.

search_driftwood.description: You pry open the hollow in the driftwood and find a packet of matches inside. Lucky find.

examine_driftwood_empty.description: The driftwood is just a piece of wood. Nothing useful here.

open_quarters.description: The rusty key turns with a screech. The door to the keeper's quarters swings open.

open_quarters_with_key.description: The rusty key turns with a screech. The door to the keeper's quarters swings open.

try_open_quarters_no_key.description: The door won't budge. It's locked tight.

open_cellar.description: The brass key fits the padlock on the iron hatch. It clicks open with a satisfying sound.

open_cellar_with_key.description: The brass key fits the padlock on the iron hatch. It clicks open with a satisfying sound.

try_open_cellar_no_key.description: The hatch is secured with a heavy padlock. You'll need a key.

take_oil.description: You carefully pour lamp oil into a container. The oil shimmers with a faint blue hue.

fill_lamp.description:
You pour the lamp oil into the lamp's reservoir. The wick darkens as it absorbs the fuel.
The lamp is ready to be lit.

light_lamp.description:
You strike a match and touch the flame to the wick.
The lamp ignites with a warm golden glow.
The Fresnel lens catches the light and throws it outward in a brilliant beam.

Then the impossible happens.

Through the fog-pressed windows, you see them - lights beneath the waves. Dozens at first, then hundreds, then thousands. They rise from the deep in spiraling patterns, answering the beacon's call.

The lighthouse wasn't built to warn ships away from the rocks.
It was built to call THEM home.

The humming grows louder. The light pulses in rhythm with the glowing moss far below.
You understand now. The keeper never left.
The keeper became the light.

try_fill_no_oil.description: The lamp's reservoir is empty. You need lamp oil to fill it.

try_light_no_matches.description: The lamp is filled but you have nothing to light it with.

try_light_empty_lamp.description: The lamp is empty. There's nothing to light.

read_journal.description:
You read through the journal's entries. Early pages describe routine lighthouse keeping - oil levels, weather logs, ship passages.
But the later entries grow strange:

'November 12th. The lights below the waves are brighter tonight. They pulse in patterns I cannot decipher. Elara says they are learning the signal.'

'November 28th. The fog has not lifted. The radio is dead. But the lights below - they understand now. They mirror the beacon's rhythm.'

The final entry is barely legible:

'December 31st. I can hear them singing. Not with voices - with light. They want the beacon lit. They have been waiting so long. When it burns again, the doorway opens. I will stay. Someone must keep the signal alive.'

win_event.description:
The beam of the lighthouse sweeps across the ocean, and beneath the waves, a galaxy of lights answers.
You are no longer afraid. You understand your purpose now.

The fog begins to lift. Dawn is coming.
But you know you will not leave.

You are the keeper now.
